** Minor** · **Stability & Availability** · **Quick win** **Give the second export a distinct plan ID.** The removed delay no longer separates the exports in time. `ProfileViewModel._newExportId` uses the plan ID and the current millisecond, so both exports can receive the same ID. The test then fails even when cleanup ordering works. ([github.com](https://github.com/ruxenb/LongvitaRC/blob/dab065d31891345b2d63cfe419cdb4a76aa7898f/lib/viewmodels/profile_viewmodel.dart)) Use `planFor('uid-a').copyWith(id: 'second-plan')` for the second export to keep the UID unchanged and make the IDs deterministic. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruxenb/LongvitaRC/dab065d31891345b2d63cfe419cdb4a76aa7898f/lib/models/meal_plan_model.dart))
